Total city rate 4.5, so B_c is identical whether computed as total/4.5 or regular/3.0. Pub 718 combined 8.875 inside vs 8.375 outside: the city takes the county's full 4.0 and adds 0.5 on top. OSC Fig 2 lists 3.0, the regular portion only. This is the only published NY example of a 0.5-point intra-county rate differential -- the economic analog for Albany's proposal, not a legal precedent, since Yonkers' extra half point sits on top of full preemption of the county rate.
